title: Petrichor
description: Final project for my Computer Tools for Musicians class at Tufts. Produced in Digital Performer 11, featuring my vocals accompanied by synthesizers from Reason and MOTU.

title: Thinking of Her
description: The first track in my two-song Lofi single 'Thinking of Her', produced in Logic Pro X. This song started as a loop I made for my game design class for a game centered around cheese, but it found a new meaning when I completed the track.

title: Close Your Eyes
description: The second half of my two-song Lofi single 'Thinking of Her', produced in Logic Pro X.

title: Save the Last Dance for Me
description: My senior solo arrangement for the Tufts Beelzebubs — a 15-person TTBB a cappella group. We performed it in funny costumes, which is a Beelzebubs tradition.

title: What's New Scooby-Doo?
description: Arranged for a 12-person TTBB a cappella group, appearing on the Tufts Beelzebubs EP 'School's Out', released December 2024.
